description: Verify that echoCommonDatatypes echoes a nine-tuple (Bool..Double) in REVERSED order
approach:
[Objective]
All-types canon: DUT reads nine SOME/IP common datatypes (Bool, UInt8/16/32/64, Int8/16/32/64, Float, Double) and echoes them in reverse order — exercises the full type system.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → Tester: OfferService.
2. Tester → DUT: Method Request (per-case shape).
3. Observation: DUT → Tester: Method Response (or absence) per the asserted behaviour.

[Pass condition]
DUT-emitted response satisfies the spec property.

[Fail condition]
Per-phase Fail_phase<n>_* per the verdict list.

verdicts.Fail_phase2_payload_mismatch: echoCommonDatatypes response did not match reversed
verdicts.Fail_phase2_no_response: No Method Response within listen window
